svg.title: D, P_f and P_f D, EX02
svg.desc: The n by n integer grids of D (cyclic forward difference), P_f and P_f D for EX02 with each row of P_f and P_f D labelled x>s_x, as Lean evaluates them (blue -1, orange +1); row x of P_f D has -1 in column s_x and +1 in column s_x+1.
svg.text: row label x>s_x. Row x of P_f D: minus one at column s_x, plus one at the next.
